v38_attribution.attribution_scope: synthetic dev only; geometric proxies, not production masks

raster.source: ProductionRasterFrameDecoder decoded immutable original Gray8 and BGR24 planes

marker_centers.reason: ProductionMarkerCenterAdapter runs after OCR and receives the post-OCR marker frame.

connecting_line_geometry.reason: Connection graph construction runs after OCR and marker detection; no pre-OCR edge geometry input exists.

ocr_text_boxes.reason: Detected regions and masks are produced by OCR; no prior text-box input exists before detector inference.

truth_annotations.reason: Synthetic annotation records are evaluation-only and real/private truth cannot enter production preprocessing.

semantic_phase_truth.reason: Phase semantics are resolved after OCR and marker grouping; only axis-provided line geometry is pre-OCR.

category_derivability.production_evidence: CreateOcrDetectorImage rasterizes XAxis, YAxis, tick, phase-divider, and ambiguous-grid lines with a fixed 2-pixel radius into the detector-only derivative.
category_derivability.v39_action: no new suppression; already covered by existing production path

category_derivability.production_evidence: AxisGeometryResult.PhaseDividers and AmbiguousGridOrDividers are available before OCR and already included in CreateOcrDetectorImage.
category_derivability.limitation: Undetected or semantically inferred dividers are not available without future phase evidence.

category_derivability.production_evidence: The V38 proxy uses marker annotations and marker masks, while production marker centers and connections occur after OCR.
category_derivability.v39_action: blocked; do not use future marker outputs or truth annotations as detector inputs

category_derivability.production_evidence: The V38 proxy expands synthetic text truth boxes; production OCR boxes do not exist until detector inference completes.
category_derivability.v39_action: blocked; do not use truth boxes or a circular OCR-derived mask

category_derivability.production_evidence: V38 assigns residual dark pixels by a diagnostic raster threshold, not a runtime structural identity.
category_derivability.v39_action: blocked; darkness alone would risk suppressing text

category_derivability.production_evidence: The category is a residual attribution bucket, not a known structure mask.
category_derivability.v39_action: blocked; no safe structural suppression is defined

retained_candidate_contract_if_unblocked.train_scenes: V37 train scenes and deterministic V37 degradation variants
retained_candidate_contract_if_unblocked.single_change: one deterministic suppression derived solely from an existing pre-OCR production input

decision.reason: The V38 dominant false-positive category requires marker or connecting-line outputs that run after OCR, while text-margin and residual categories rely on truth-only or post-OCR data. Existing axis/tick/divider suppression is already applied before OCR, so no distinct runtime-compatible single change remains.
decision.next_safe_action: Add a new pre-OCR structural provider contract only after an approved production design identifies inputs available before OCR; then prepare one synthetic candidate retaining the frozen V37/V38 contract.
